title: Choose the Contact Sheet layout
question: All three use the same visual style. Choose the page layout you want me to build.

options.label: A — Balanced editorial
options.lineage: large selected frame, title column, horizontal contact strip
options.thesis: The image and article title share the first screen, followed by a strong six-frame reading strip.
options.viewport: A balanced two-column feature keeps the title immediately visible while the contact strip spans the page below.
options.risk: The first screen is denser than the other layouts.

options.label: B — Cinematic sequence
options.lineage: extra-wide selected frame, caption headline, horizontal sequence
options.thesis: One wide image sets the mood first, then the title and contact strip guide the reader downward.
options.viewport: The selected image dominates the opening, with the title and six-frame strip acting as its editorial caption.
options.risk: The article title starts lower on small laptop screens.

options.label: C — Vertical index
options.lineage: vertical thumbnail rail, large selected frame, editorial detail column
options.thesis: A permanent left index makes the contact-sheet idea strongest while preserving a clear reading column.
options.viewport: Six small frames feed into one large selected image, with the article title and metadata held on the right.
options.risk: The vertical rail needs a simpler mobile translation.
